title: Runtime auto-load of project .env at Claude Code startup (proxy password in HTTP_PROXY)
reason_not_testable: No hook runs and no tool_response exists: the project .env is loaded by the CLI at process startup before any tool call, so no PreToolUse, PostToolUse or PostToolBatch event fires. Non-hook controls: E (keep proxy and other credentials out of project .env files; use an OS secret store or user-level env) and N (vendor fix).
